content_units: Four-Hour Daytime Drive Playlist

A bright, easy-rolling mix built for open-road momentum: indie rock, classic pop, upbeat folk, and a few big singalong moments. Everything stays clean, warm, and moving—no heavy heartbreak dips, no sluggish ballads.
Drive Phases and 20-Song Sequence
Phase   Artist   Song   Why it fits
1   Start the Engine   Katrina & The Waves   Walking on Sunshine   Instant lift-off energy for pulling out and settling into the drive.
2   Start the Engine   The Beatles   Here Comes the Sun   Bright, familiar, and breezy without pushing too hard too early.
3   Start the Engine   Edward Sharpe & The Magnetic Zeros   Home   Loose, sunny folk-pop that feels made for daytime miles.
4   Start the Engine   The Lumineers   Ho Hey   A stomp-and-clap singalong that keeps the mood light.
5   Start the Engine   Haim   The Wire   Snappy indie-pop rhythm that adds motion without getting aggressive.
6   Cruise Control Glow   Tom Petty   Runnin' Down a Dream   A road-trip staple with steady forward drive and zero drag.
7   Cruise Control Glow   George Ezra   Shotgun   Playful, bouncy, and perfect for mid-morning highway ease.
8   Cruise Control Glow   Vance Joy   Saturday Sun   Smooth, upbeat, and relaxed like a clean stretch of open road.
9   Cruise Control Glow   Fleetwood Mac   Everywhere   Polished classic pop that glides beautifully in daylight.
10   Cruise Control Glow   Phoenix   Lisztomania   Crisp indie energy to keep attention and momentum high.
11   Windows Down Stretch   Rusted Root   Send Me On My Way   Pure road-trip joy with a rolling, carefree pulse.
12   Windows Down Stretch   American Authors   Best Day of My Life   Big chorus, bright mood, and easy group singalong appeal.
13   Windows Down Stretch   The Proclaimers   I'm Gonna Be (500 Miles)   Cheerful, shameless, and ideal once everyone is fully warmed up.
14   Windows Down Stretch   WALK THE MOON   Shut Up and Dance   The highest-energy section of the drive without tipping into chaos.
15   Windows Down Stretch   Bleachers   I Wanna Get Better   Punchy and uplifting, with strong motion for the late-drive push.
16   Golden-Hour Finish   Vampire Weekend   Holiday   Light, nimble indie-pop to keep the landing stretch fun.
17   Golden-Hour Finish   Electric Light Orchestra   Mr. Blue Sky   One of the best late-drive sunshine songs ever recorded.
18   Golden-Hour Finish   The Head and the Heart   All We Ever Knew   Upbeat folk-rock that feels expansive and easygoing.
19   Golden-Hour Finish   Weezer   Island in the Sun   Calm-cruise tempo with a familiar, relaxed glow.
19   Golden-Hour Finish   Weezer   Island in the Sun   Calm-cruise tempo with a familiar, relaxed glow.  , Each Phase.
20   Golden-Hour Finish   The Turtles   Happy Together   A warm, classic singalong to close the drive on a smile.
Phase-by-Phase Flow
Phase 1: Start the Engine
The first 45–60 minutes ease you into the drive with bright hooks, acoustic lift, and friendly singalongs that feel energetic but not rushed.
Phase 2: Cruise Control Glow
This section settles into a smooth highway rhythm with melodic indie and classic pop that keeps the mood buoyant and steady.
Phase 3: Windows Down Stretch
The liveliest stretch of the playlist—bigger choruses, stronger bounce, and crowd-pleasing singalong tracks for peak daytime momentum.
Phase 4: Golden-Hour Finish
The final hour stays upbeat but slightly more relaxed, giving you a polished, sunlit landing instead of an energy crash.
